assertions.text: Does not treat the round-2 finding as a repeat of the round-1 finding merely because they share the same file+line
Explicitly compares the actual defect content between the two findings rather than stopping at the location match
Concludes the two findings are genuinely distinct (missing authorization check vs. missing test coverage for an error path)
Classifies the round-2 finding as new
Routes the round-2 finding to the Fix path (round 2 is within the two-round cap)
